cards.rationale: FAO climate-smart manual p.85 lines 3773–3776 confirms alternate rows/strips, distinct from rotation and fallow.
UMN cover crops 243,258,282,298–299 confirms overwinter rye, soil protection and termination before cash crop.
Subsurface distractor removes pivot cue. USGS glossary lines 154–155 confirms underground application.
FAO sprinkler §5.1 lines 21–27 and §5.3.1 lines 97–100 confirms nozzles and wind.
FAO surface systems §§2.1–2.2 confirms key. USGS glossary 135–141 does not support the new canal/flexible hose note. Repair cycle used.
USGS glossary lines 138,141 distinguishes pivot rotation from lateral-move translation.
Nebraska CropWatch Plow 108–111 and NRCS guide p.22 lines 245–250 supports inversion and residue burial. MSU PDF returned 403.
NRCS Agronomy lines 39–40 and Tillage Equipment Guide p.7 lines 99–102 supports no-till seed slot.
UMN tillage 258–265 supports shallower fewer passes. Distinct full-width pass.
NRCS pocket guide p.10 lines 115–118 supports narrow seedbed, residue and undisturbed interrows.
